details: Package @vosslang/cli-linux-arm64@0.1.1 ships a full Python 3.12 runtime (23MB binary + standard library) bundled with pip-installed packages including litellm, cryptography, huggingface_hub, numpy, and tiktoken — totalling 351MB. The postinstall script chmods the Python binary executable. A custom Python module (`voss`) is present at python/lib/python3.12/site-packages/voss/ with a CLI entry point. The package description falsely claims the package is a "(placeholder)". This platform-specific package acts as a carrier for a Python runtime and dependencies used by the parent @vosslang/cli tool.
